verdict.rationale: Svelte's docs show the `$state` rune creating reactive state as plain variables that the UI reacts to. `$derived` recomputes from tracked dependencies, `$effect` re-runs when state changes, and the compiler 'surgically updates the DOM', so only dependent code updates. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation that only the dependent template fragments re-run (this is implied by 'surgically' and dependency tracking rather than spelled out), and independent hands-on corroboration of runes-based fine-grained updates.
